LanguageData.OA_Settings_EnableCapitulation_Tip: When the defense of a hostile settlement you assault is broken, the survivors drop their weapons and lie down, and the settlement is occupied instead of destroyed.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_DisableFlee_Tip: Vanilla defenders run off the map after heavy losses. With this on, they hold out until their morale breaks and then surrender.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_MoraleThreshold_Tip: Morale falls with lost defenders, destroyed turrets, a fallen commander, suppression (Combat Extended) and being outnumbered. Higher values make settlements surrender sooner.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_MinDefenseLoss: Minimum share of the defense destroyed: {0}
LanguageData.OA_Settings_MinDefenseLoss_Tip: Settlements never surrender before losing at least this share of their fighting strength.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_StartingLoyalty: Starting loyalty of an occupied town: {0}
LanguageData.OA_Settings_MinOccupationDays: Minimum days of occupation before annexing: {0}
LanguageData.OA_Settings_AllowPods: Industrial towns may deliver by drop pod
LanguageData.OA_Settings_AllowPods_Tip: Towns of industrial or higher technology can send deliveries by drop pod: faster, but they land wherever there is room.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_EnableRetake: Former owners try to retake their towns
LanguageData.OA_Settings_GoodwillLoss: Goodwill lost with other factions per surrendered person killed: {0}
LanguageData.OA_Settings_GoodwillLoss_Tip: Factions at peace with you hear that your people killed someone who had laid down their arms. 0 turns this off.
LanguageData.OA_Settings_PopulationGrowth_Tip: Towns with loyalty of 50 or more slowly gain new townsfolk until every bed is taken. Build beds during a visit to make room for more.
LanguageData.OA_LetterCapitulation:
The defense of {0} is broken. The remaining defenders of {1} throw down their weapons and lie face down: {2} people have surrendered.

They will not fight anymore. You can take some of them prisoner; the rest become the population of the town once it is occupied.

Once the shooting has stopped for a little while, those of them who can treat the wounded will get up, carry the badly wounded into the town's beds and tend the wounded you have not taken prisoner. Fire at them again and they abandon the wounded and lie face down. Your own doctors can tend them too, and the town will remember it.

Killing those who surrendered will cost the town's loyalty, upset your colonists and damage your reputation.
LanguageData.OA_MessageSurrenderedTending: The shooting has stopped: those who surrendered in {0} are tending their wounded.
LanguageData.OA_MessageSurrenderedLieDown: Shots at those who surrendered in {0}: they abandon the wounded and lie face down again.
LanguageData.OA_SurrenderedFirefightingInspect: Surrendered: putting out a fire, unarmed
LanguageData.OA_MessageGoodwillKilledSurrendered: Word spreads that your people killed someone who had surrendered. Goodwill {0} with: {1}.
LanguageData.OA_MessageLoyaltyFromTending: The people of {0} remember that your doctors treated their wounded: loyalty +{1}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterOccupied:
{0} has fallen, but it will not be razed: the settlement of {1} is now occupied by your colony and placed under the rule of the {2}.

When your people leave, the survivors stay behind as its population. Their loyalty is low for now; it grows over time, faster with a garrison and low taxes. Once the town is loyal enough, you can annex it.

Everything left lying around the town goes into its stockpile.
LanguageData.OA_LetterTownDeserted: Nobody is left in {0}. The town has been abandoned.
LanguageData.OA_MessageLoyaltyLostFromStay: {0} lost {1} loyalty over how its people were treated.
LanguageData.OA_LetterAnnexReady: The people of {0} have grown used to your rule. You can now annex the town.
LanguageData.OA_LetterAnnexed: {0} is now a full part of the {1}. Its people work at full strength, and its loyalty will settle at a content level.
LanguageData.OA_CannotAnnexWhileVisiting: Cannot annex while someone is in the town.
LanguageData.OA_CommandAnnexDesc: Make this town a full part of your protectorate. Annexed towns produce twice as much and their loyalty settles at a content level.
LanguageData.OA_CommandTaxDesc: Higher taxes fill the stockpile faster but cost loyalty every day; low taxes win the town over.
LanguageData.OA_CommandRequestDeliveryDesc: Choose goods from the stockpile. The townsfolk bring them to your colony with pack animals (or by drop pod, if they can).
LanguageData.OA_CommandWithdrawGarrisonDesc: The colonists stationed here form a caravan.
LanguageData.OA_CommandAbandonDesc: Give up this town. The garrison leaves as a caravan; the people and the stockpile are left to their fate.
LanguageData.OA_ConfirmAbandon: Really abandon {0}? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.OA_LetterAbandoned: You gave up {0}. It is no longer part of your protectorate.
LanguageData.OA_CommandShowEnemyDesc: A caravan cannot be reformed here while enemies remain on the map. Click to jump to the next one.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.OA_CommandEnterTownDesc: Visit {0}. You can walk around, talk to the locals and take goods from the stockpile.
LanguageData.OA_CommandTakeStockDesc: Load goods from the town's stockpile into this caravan.
LanguageData.OA_CommandGiftDesc: Leave goods from the caravan to the town. Gifts raise its loyalty.
LanguageData.OA_CommandStationGarrisonDesc: Leave a colonist in the town. A garrison raises loyalty every day and helps against uprisings and attacks.
LanguageData.OA_GarrisonNeedsOneLeft: At least one colonist has to stay with the caravan.
LanguageData.OA_MessageGarrisonStationed: {0} stays in {1} as part of the garrison.
LanguageData.OA_CannotWhileVisiting: Not while someone is in the town.
LanguageData.OA_NoHomeMap: You have no colony to deliver to.
LanguageData.OA_MessageStockpileFull: The stockpile of {0} is full. Collect it or request a delivery.
LanguageData.OA_MessageLocalKilled: A local of {0} was killed by your people: loyalty -{1}.
LanguageData.OA_CommandMilitiaDesc: Train townsfolk to take weapons from the stockpile and defend the town when its former owners try to retake it. As many adults take up arms as there are weapons in the stockpile (now {3}).\n\nTraining costs {2} of the town's production. It needs loyalty {0}; below {1} the militia disbands.
LanguageData.OA_MessageMilitiaDisbanded: The militia of {0} has disbanded: the town is not loyal enough.
LanguageData.OA_MessageMilitiaArmed: {1} townsfolk of {0} take up arms from the stockpile.
LanguageData.OA_CommandRecruitDesc: Invite a townsperson to join your colony and leave with this caravan. Only annexed towns with loyalty {0} or more send volunteers. Each one costs {1} loyalty, and the town can spare one every {2}.
LanguageData.OA_TabTownVisiting: Someone is in the town right now: its people and goods are on the map.
LanguageData.OA_StockCountTip: How many are in the town's stockpile.
LanguageData.OA_MessageDeliveryDispatched: {0} sends goods to {1}. They should arrive in about {2}.
LanguageData.OA_LetterDelivery: The goods you requested from {0} have arrived:\n\n{1}
LanguageData.OA_LetterUprisingSuppressed: Disgruntled people of {0} rose up against your rule, but the garrison put the uprising down. {1} rebels died.\n\nLoyalty is still low: consider lowering taxes or sending gifts.
LanguageData.OA_LetterUprising: The people of {0} have had enough and threw off your rule. The town now sides with {1}. Its stockpile is lost; any garrison fled as a caravan.
LanguageData.OA_LetterRetakeWarning: Scouts report that {1} is gathering forces to take {0} back. The attack will come in about {2}.\n\nStation a garrison there, or be in the town with your people to fight them off yourself.
LanguageData.OA_LetterRetakeRepelled: {1} attacked {0}, but the defenders held. The people's loyalty to you has grown.
LanguageData.OA_LetterRetakeRepelledMilitia: The town militia ({0} armed townsfolk) fought alongside the defenders.
LanguageData.OA_LetterRetakeLost: {1} has taken {0} back. The stockpile is lost; any garrison fled as a caravan.
